subject.title: fix(qa): Mantis before-after exits when a lane command stalls

question: Should Mantis before/after use the proposed fixed command-stage timeout and inactivity policy for worktree, install, build, QA, and cleanup operations?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes failure timing and process termination for real QA operator workflows; the correct budget and diagnostic tradeoff are product-owner decisions rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept the proposed policy
options.body: Confirm the documented inactivity and stage budgets as the supported Mantis operator contract, then merge after normal checks complete.

options.title: Revise the stage policy
options.body: Ask for QA Lab-specific timing or cancellation adjustments and focused evidence for the revised real-lane behavior.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until a QA Lab owner defines a supported timeout contract for silent lane commands.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed policy
recommendation.body: Confirm the documented inactivity and stage budgets as the supported Mantis operator contract, then merge after normal checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented and documented the proposed command-stage policy, though a named current-main QA Lab owner was not established in the supplied evidence.
